description: rnews.rs lines 233-254 and rnews_ingest.rs lines 52-73 contain byte-for-byte identical make_article() and make_batch() helper functions. In Rust, sharing helpers between a crate's #[cfg(test)] module and its integration tests (tests/) requires a tests/common/ module or a dev-dependency helper crate. The duplication is small (two functions, ~25 lines) but creates a maintenance hazard: a future change to the batch format (e.g. adding a trailing newline) must be made in both places. If these helpers grow, consolidate into tests/common/rnews_helpers.rs and pub use from both sites.
title: make_article/make_batch helpers duplicated across unit and integration tests
